Hello Hiring Team,

I am a Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, and database technologies. I have experience building scalable web applications, REST APIs, and enterprise solutions. I am interested in exploring suitable opportunities with your organization. Please find my resume for your consideration.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Abdul Razzaque

standard_answers.tell_me_about_yourself: I am a Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience architecting end-to-end web applications, scalable backend microservices, and modern state-driven frontends. My core stack includes React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. I have delivered enterprise platforms, scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud deployments on AWS and Docker, with a strong focus on clean architecture, system reliability, and business impact.
standard_answers.strengths: My primary strengths are end-to-end technical ownership, rapid problem-solving, and architecting resilient full-stack systems. I write clean, maintainable code, optimize database performance for high concurrency, and communicate clearly across cross-functional distributed teams.
standard_answers.handling_difficult_situations: When facing complex technical challenges or unexpected blockers, I isolate the root cause through system logs and telemetry, analyze architectural trade-offs, and implement a robust, well-tested solution while keeping team stakeholders transparently informed.
standard_answers.managing_deadlines: I manage deadlines by breaking complex epics into prioritized milestones, identifying critical-path dependencies early, utilizing CI/CD automation, and proactively communicating with product managers to maintain steady delivery velocity without compromising quality.
standard_answers.challenging_project: In a recent project, I architected a high-concurrency microservice system with real-time updates and high throughput. By designing an event-driven workflow using Node.js, Redis caching, and PostgreSQL connection pooling, we reduced API response latency by over 40% and maintained 99.9% uptime during peak traffic.
standard_answers.handling_conflicts: I approach disagreements with an objective, data-driven mindset. I listen actively to understand different technical viewpoints, evaluate trade-offs based on maintainability and business impact, and collaborate to reach a consensus that best serves the product.
standard_answers.working_under_pressure: Under high pressure or urgent production incidents, I stay calm, prioritize urgent high-impact fixes, eliminate non-essential context switching, and execute solutions step-by-step while maintaining open communication with stakeholders.
standard_answers.remote_collaboration_methods: I maintain high alignment through structured daily standups, clear asynchronous documentation in Jira and Confluence, timely communication via Slack and Teams, and well-reviewed PRs on GitHub and GitLab. I proactively manage time zone differences by planning overlapping working hours for synchronous collaboration.
standard_answers.remote_collaboration_tools: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, Jira, Trello, Asana, Notion, GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, Figma
standard_answers.programming_languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL, C, C++
standard_answers.frontend_technologies: React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, HTML5, CSS3
standard_answers.backend_technologies: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, Socket.io, Prisma, Mongoose
standard_answers.cloud_devops_technologies: AWS (EC2, S3), Docker, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions
